title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming parity + ergonomics, bump versions to v1.206.0
author: Ava Martinez
description: Summary: Unify authentication header handling and retry primitives across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs, complete streaming API parity and improve ergonomics for common patterns. Motivation: Multiple SDKs diverged on header normalization and retry semantics which caused production inconsistencies; streaming implementations had minor API surface differences that complicated cross-language examples. This PR: 1) centralizes auth token handling and automatic refresh hooks; 2) provides a single RetryPolicy config with consistent backoff defaults and idempotency semantics; 3) implements TS/Go streaming parity with Python (chunked event framing + reconnection helpers); 4) improves ergonomics (context managers in Python, async iterator patterns in TS, simpler client constructor in Go); 5) bumps package versions and updates changelogs. Checklist: [x] core implementation in all three SDKs [x] unit/integration tests updated [x] docs/changelogs updated [x] migration notes included Impact: Backwards compatible defaults preserved; opt-in changes for improved ergonomics. Migration: clients can continue to pass raw tokens but are encouraged to use the new CredentialProvider interface for managed refresh. Related: ENG-3421, ENG-3500, PM-210.
commits: Unify auth header handling across SDKs and add CredentialProvider abstraction
